jobs.title: Team Lead ICT Engineering & Operations
jobs.description:
Founded in 1968, SKAN is a pioneer in cleanroom equipment and the development of isolators for the pharmaceutical industry. Innovative products, tailor-made solutions and an effective service organisation have made SKAN a market leader and a key partner to industry and research laboratories.
Overview
In this key role, you and your team will be responsible for the further development of our hybrid ICT infrastructure and will actively drive the transformation toward the cloud.
You combine technical architectural expertise with operational excellence and know how to develop teams both professionally and personally. Together with your team, you ensure stable, secure, and future-proof ICT operations for our international organization.
Responsibilities
- Technical and operational leadership of the ICT Engineering & Operations team
- Responsibility for the stable, secure, and high-performance operation of the hybrid ICT infrastructure
- Planning, managing, and implementing infrastructure and cloud projects from conception through to successful go-live
- Further development of the Microsoft-based system landscape in a hybrid environment (on-premises & Azure)
- Active involvement in shaping and implementing the cloud strategy
- Evaluation and migration of existing services to hybrid or cloud-based architectures
- Responsibility for modern identity and access concepts using Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory
- Definition and further development of technical standards, operational, and automation concepts
- Active involvement in shaping, applying, and continuously developing established ITIL processes
- Integration of international locations into a standardized and scalable infrastructure
- Supporting the team with complex technical issues and contributing to 2nd/3rd-level support
- Coaching and professional development of team members
- Close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external partners, and suppliers
Hardskills
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a comparable qualification
- Several years of experience in senior technical roles within an enterprise infrastructure environment
- Extensive experience in the engineering and operation of complex hybrid ICT infrastructures
Excellent knowledge of the Microsoft Server environment
- In-depth experience with Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Active Directory, and Group Policy
- Experience with hybrid cloud architectures and cloud migrations
- Knowledge of automation and standardization of operational processes
- Experience with backup and recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam)
- Good knowledge of networking, VPN, security, and infrastructure concepts
- PowerShell and automation experience is a plus
- Excellent German and English language skills
Softskills
- Solution-oriented and highly effective in implementation
- High level of technical and professional expertise
- Confident demeanor and strong communication skills
- Ability to effectively combine operational implementation, IT service management, and strategic development
- Hands-on mentality with a high degree of personal responsibility
- Calm and structured approach to work, even in challenging situations
- Enjoyment of developing teams and actively shaping change
- Analytical mindset and a strong focus on service and customer satisfaction
We offer you
- An open and collaborative corporate culture
- Freedom to contribute and develop ideas
- Opportunities to participate in sports and social activities
- Professional development and continuous learning opportunities, especially at our SKAN Academy
- Comprehensive and career-focused onboarding
- Quick decision-making paths and flat hierarchies
- Transparent and open communication
- 5 weeks of vacation, with the option to take additional leave
Additional information
We look forward to receiving your complete application documents (CV, diplomas and employment references) via our career page.
For this position, we are focusing on direct applications and are not working with external agencies. Any dossiers submitted by agencies will not be processed.
For questions please contact Viviane Braxton.

Unisci competenze architettoniche tecniche all'eccellenza operativa e sai come sviluppare team sia professionalmente che personalmente. Insieme al vostro team, assicurate le operazioni ICT stabili, sicure e a prova di futuro per la nostra organizzazione internazionale.

- Responsabilità per il funzionamento stabile, sicuro e ad alte prestazioni dell'infrastruttura ICT ibrida

- Ulteriore sviluppo del panorama di sistema basato su Microsoft in un ambiente ibrido (on-premises & Azure)
- Il coinvolgimento attivo nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia cloud

- Definizione e sviluppo dei concetti di standard tecnici, operativi e di automazione
- Il coinvolgimento attivo nella formazione, applicazione e sviluppo continuo dei processi ITIL consolidati

- Coaching e sviluppo professionale dei membri del team
- Chiudi la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni, i partner esterni e i fornitori
Hardskills
- Corso di laurea o master in informatica o una qualifica paragonabile
- Diversi anni di esperienza in ruoli tecnici senior all'interno di un ambiente di infrastruttura aziendale
- Ampia esperienza nell'ingegneria e nel funzionamento di complesse infrastrutture ICT ibride
Ottima conoscenza dell'ambiente Microsoft Server
- Esperienza approfondita con Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Active Directory e Criteri di gruppo
- Esperienza con architetture cloud ibride e migrazioni cloud
- Conoscenza dell'automazione e della standardizzazione dei processi operativi
- Esperienza con soluzioni di backup e ripristino (ad esempio, Veeam)
- Buona conoscenza dei concetti di rete, VPN, sicurezza e infrastrutture
- PowerShell e l'esperienza di automazione è un plus
- Eccellente tedesco e inglese competenze linguistiche
Softskills
- Soluzione orientata e altamente efficace nell'implementazione
- Alto livello di competenza tecnica e professionale
- Confident demeanor e forti capacità di comunicazione
- Capacità di combinare efficacemente l'implementazione operativa, la gestione dei servizi IT e lo sviluppo strategico
- mentalità a mano con un alto grado di responsabilità personale
- Approccio calmo e strutturato al lavoro, anche in situazioni difficili
- Il godimento delle squadre in via di sviluppo e la formazione attiva del cambiamento
- Mindset analitico e una forte attenzione al servizio e alla soddisfazione del cliente
Vi offriamo
- Una cultura aziendale aperta e collaborativa
- Libertà di contribuire e sviluppare idee
- Opportunità di partecipare alle attività sportive e sociali
- Sviluppo professionale e opportunità di apprendimento continuo, soprattutto presso la nostra SKAN Academy
- Integrato e orientato alla carriera a bordo
- Rapidi percorsi decisionali e gerarchie piatte
- Comunicazione trasparente e aperta

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i vostri documenti applicativi completi (CV, diplomi e riferimenti di lavoro) attraverso la nostra pagina di carriera.

Dans ce rôle clé, vous et votre équipe serez responsables du développement ultérieur de notre infrastructure hybride de TIC et dirigerez activement la transformation vers le cloud.
Vous combinez l'expertise technique en architecture avec l'excellence opérationnelle et savez développer des équipes à la fois professionnellement et personnellement. Avec votre équipe, vous assurez des opérations TIC stables, sûres et à l'épreuve du futur pour notre organisation internationale.

- Direction technique et opérationnelle de l'équipe d'ingénierie et d'exploitation des TIC
- Responsabilité du fonctionnement stable, sûr et performant de l'infrastructure hybride TIC
- Planification, gestion et mise en œuvre de projets d'infrastructure et de cloud, de la conception à la réussite

- Participation active à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie cloud

- Collaboration étroite avec les intervenants internes, les partenaires externes et les fournisseurs

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou une qualification comparable
- Plusieurs années d'expérience dans des rôles techniques de haut niveau dans un environnement d'infrastructure d'entreprise

- Expérience approfondie avec Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, Active Directory et Group Policy
- Expérience des architectures de nuages hybrides et des migrations de nuages
- Connaissance de l'automatisation et de la normalisation des processus opérationnels
- Expérience des solutions de sauvegarde et de récupération (par exemple Veeam)
- Bonne connaissance des concepts de réseau, VPN, sécurité et infrastructure
- PowerShell et l'expérience d'automatisation est un plus
- Excellentes compétences en langue allemande et anglaise
Compétences diverses
- Orientation vers des solutions et mise en œuvre très efficace
- Haute compétence technique et professionnelle
- Atténuation de la confiance et maîtrise de la communication
- Capacité de combiner efficacement la mise en oeuvre opérationnelle, la gestion des services de TI et le développement stratégique
- Une mentalité pratique avec un haut degré de responsabilité personnelle
- Une approche du travail calme et structurée, même dans des situations difficiles
- Appréciation des équipes en développement et évolution active

Overview
For our ICT Engineering & Operations Team, we are looking for an experienced Senior ICT System Engineer / Technical Project Lead with in-depth expertise in Microsoft-based hybrid cloud infrastructures. In this role, you will actively contribute to the further development of our ICT landscape and take technical responsibility for challenging infrastructure and cloud projects. You will connect on-premises systems with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 and drive topics such as cloud integration, Identity & Access Management, security, standardization, and automation. You will combine strong technical engineering expertise with project responsibility.
Responsibilities
- Lead and technically coordinate ICT infrastructure and hybrid cloud projects from planning through implementation
- Design, operate, and further develop our hybrid Microsoft infrastructure, including on-premises systems, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365
- Administer and further develop Microsoft Entra ID, Identity & Access Management (IAM), as well as PKI and certificate services, including MFA, Conditional Access, role and authorization concepts, and certificate lifecycle management
- Further develop and modernize central Windows Server, Active Directory, and cloud services, including the gradual migration to hybrid and cloud-based architectures
- Integrate remote locations into a standardized, secure, and scalable ICT infrastructure
- Contribute to the design and further development of security, governance, backup, recovery, and data concepts
- Standardize and automate operational and administrative processes, particularly using PowerShell
- Ensure stable, secure, and high-performing operations and support troubleshooting, root cause analyses, and complex 2nd- and 3rd-level issues
- Create technical documentation and collaborate with internal stakeholders, external partners, and suppliers
Hardskills
- Degree in Computer Science, higher professional qualification, or a comparable qualification
- At least 5 years of professional experience in ICT infrastructure, ideally including experience in technical project management
- In-depth experience with Microsoft-based hybrid cloud infrastructures
- Very good knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Entra ID
- Experience with Identity & Access Management, MFA, Conditional Access, RBAC, and hybrid identity scenarios
- In-depth experience with Microsoft PKI / Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), certificate management, and certificate lifecycle management
- Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy (GPO)
- Experience in integrating and modernizing on-premises and cloud infrastructures
- Experience with cloud migration projects and the automation of operational and administrative tasks
- In-depth knowledge of ITIL and practical experience with IT service management processes, particularly Incident, Problem, and Change Management, is required
Softskills
- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical topics in a way that is appropriate for different audiences
- Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented approach, combined with a high degree of initiative and a hands-on mindset
- Ability to effectively combine technical engineering, operational responsibility, and project management
- Strong team spirit, collaboration skills, and service orientation when working with different stakeholders
- Ability to prepare, justify, and confidently communicate technical decisions
- Openness to continuous learning and new cloud, security, automation, and AI technologies
We offer you

- Freedom to contribute and develop ideas
- Opportunities to participate in sports and social activities

- Transparent and open communication
